headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Munsif Daily / Deccan Chronicle / Times of India / The Hindu
bullets_en: LG appoints Syed Faisal Qadri as J-K advocate general.
NRR Sees Cong. Rout in Telangana, Slams CM.
'Privileged strategic partnership': Russian FM Lavrov hails ties with India.
Saudi strike kills 11 in Yemen, reports Houthi media.
President to attend Telangana agri varsity convocation on Dec 21.
bullets_ur: LG ne Syed Faisal Qadri ko J-K ka advocate general muqarrar kar diya.
NRR ne Telangana mein Cong. ki shikast dekhi, CM par tanqeed ki.
'Privileged strategic partnership': Roosi foreign minister Lavrov ne India ke sath taaluqat ko saraaha.
Saudi hamlay mein Yemen mein 11 log halak, Houthi media ki report.
Sadar 21 December ko Telangana agri varsity ke convocation mein shirakat karenge.
